grammar.summary: 本课学习表"注定/倾向"的 be inclined to 与 be bound to。

points.title: be inclined to 表倾向
points.explanation: I am inclined to agree. 倾向于做某事。长难句中的插入语，需跳过插入成分找主干。

examples.en: People are always talking about 'the problem of youth'.
examples.cn: 人们总是谈论"青年问题"。

points.title: who = anyone who 的泛指从句
points.explanation: If there is one—which I take leave to doubt—then it is older people who create it, not the young themselves. 破折号插入 + it is...who 强调句。

examples.en: It is older people who create it, not the young themselves.
examples.cn: 是年长者制造的这一问题，而不是年轻人自己。
